de-DE.name: Dein Halloween-Kostüm
de-DE.shortDescription: Aus jedem Selfie ein gruseliges Kostüm-Porträt.
de-DE.longDescription: Den ganzen Oktober: Foto wählen, auf Halloween-Kostüm tippen – Nano Banana macht dich zu Vampir, Hexe oder Skelett.

en-AU.name: Your Halloween Costume
en-AU.shortDescription: Turn any selfie into a spooky fancy-dress snap.
en-AU.longDescription: All October: pick a photo, tap Halloween costume, and Nano Banana dresses you up as a vampire, witch or skeleton.

en-GB.name: Your Halloween Costume
en-GB.shortDescription: Turn any selfie into a spooky fancy-dress photo.
en-GB.longDescription: All October: pick a photo, tap Halloween costume, and Nano Banana dresses you up as a vampire, witch or skeleton.

en-US.name: Your Halloween Costume
en-US.shortDescription: Turn any selfie into a spooky costume portrait.
en-US.longDescription: All October: pick a photo, tap Halloween costume, and Nano Banana dresses you up as a vampire, witch or skeleton.

es-ES.name: Tu disfraz de Halloween
es-ES.shortDescription: Convierte cualquier selfie en un disfraz de miedo.
es-ES.longDescription: Todo octubre: elige una foto, toca Disfraz de Halloween y Nano Banana te viste de vampiro, bruja o esqueleto.

es-MX.name: Tu disfraz de Halloween
es-MX.shortDescription: Convierte tu selfie en un disfraz que da miedo.
es-MX.longDescription: Todo octubre: elige una foto, toca Disfraz de Halloween y Nano Banana te viste de vampiro, bruja o esqueleto.

fr-FR.name: Votre costume d'Halloween
fr-FR.shortDescription: Transformez un selfie en portrait effrayant.
fr-FR.longDescription: En octobre, touchez Costume d'Halloween sur une photo : Nano Banana vous déguise en vampire, sorcière ou squelette.

it.name: Il tuo costume di Halloween
it.shortDescription: Trasforma un selfie in un costume da paura.
it.longDescription: Tutto ottobre: scegli una foto, tocca Costume di Halloween e Nano Banana ti veste da vampiro, strega o scheletro.

ja.name: あなたのハロウィン仮装
ja.shortDescription: 自撮りが一瞬でゾクッとするコスチューム写真に。
ja.longDescription: 10月限定：写真を選んでハロウィン仮装をタップ。Nano Bananaがヴァンパイアや魔女、骸骨に変身させます。

ko.name: 나만의 할로윈 코스튬
ko.shortDescription: 셀카 한 장이 오싹한 코스튬 초상화로 변신.
ko.longDescription: 10월 한 달 내내: 사진을 고르고 할로윈 코스튬을 탭하면 Nano Banana가 뱀파이어, 마녀, 해골로 변신시켜 드려요.

pl.name: Twój strój na Halloween
pl.shortDescription: Zamień selfie w mroczny portret w przebraniu.
pl.longDescription: Październik: wybierz zdjęcie i dotknij Strój na Halloween — Nano Banana zmieni cię w wampira, czarownicę lub szkielet.

pt-BR.name: Sua fantasia de Halloween
pt-BR.shortDescription: Transforme uma selfie em retrato assustador.
pt-BR.longDescription: Em outubro: escolha uma foto, toque em Fantasia de Halloween e o Nano Banana te veste de vampiro, bruxa ou esqueleto.

zh-Hans.name: 你的万圣节装扮
zh-Hans.shortDescription: 一张自拍秒变惊悚万圣节装扮照。
zh-Hans.longDescription: 整个十月：选一张照片，点万圣节装扮，Nano Banana就把你变成吸血鬼、女巫或骷髅。

zh-Hant.name: 你的萬聖節裝扮
zh-Hant.shortDescription: 一張自拍秒變驚悚萬聖節裝扮照。
zh-Hant.longDescription: 整個十月：選一張照片，點萬聖節裝扮，Nano Banana就把你變成吸血鬼、女巫或骷髏。
